theorem norm_Gr_le_closed (s : ℂ) (δ : ℝ) {θ : ℝ} (hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ : θ < π / 4)
    (hs0 : -1 ≤ s.re) (hs1 : s.re ≤ 1) :
    ‖Gr s δ 0‖ ≤ Real.exp (-(θ * |s.im|)) *
      (Real.exp ((2 * π * |δ| * Real.sin θ) ^ 2 / (2 * Real.cos (2 * θ))) *
        ((1 + (2 * π * |δ| * Real.sin θ / Real.cos (2 * θ)) ^ 2) * √(π / (Real.cos (2 * θ) / 2)) +
          √π / (Real.cos (2 * θ) * √(Real.cos (2 * θ) / 2)))) :=

note: I₁ ≤ x₀^{−σ}√(2π)e^{−ℜφ(u₀,₊)} and I₂ ≤ (π^{3/2}/4)x₀^{−σ}e^{−ℜφ(u₀,₊)} are right. Erratum: For ell<0 the book bounds the L_3 integral using int_{-oo}^{-ell} e^{-t^2/2}dt <= sqrt(pi/2)e^{-ell^2/2}, which needs ell>=0; at delta=1, s=1/2+i, |F_delta(s)| = 0.0430 while the right sides of (8.47) and (8.3) are 7.83e-9 and 1.65e-8 (checked by `scripts/checks/eq_8_47.py`).
